faq.title: Jaguar XK AJ8FT FAQs
faq.description: Answers about costs, codes, warranty and fitting for the naturally aspirated Jaguar XK AJ8FT 4.2 V8.

faqs.q: How much does a Jaguar XK AJ8FT engine replacement cost?
faqs.a: It depends on whether you choose a used, reconditioned or rebuilt engine and whether we fit it. Send your registration for an itemised written quote covering parts and labour.

faqs.q: Do your AJ8FT engines include a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Every engine we supply carries a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for outside fitting, before you order.

faqs.q: Did the 2006 Jaguar XK use this engine?
faqs.a: Yes. The X150 XK launched in 2006 with the naturally aspirated 4.2 V8, which catalogues list under codes including AJ8FT. It was replaced by the 5.0 V8 from 2009.

faqs.q: Is the XK 4.2 V8 rated at 296hp?
faqs.a: A 300PS rating equals roughly 296hp, though catalogues list figures between 298hp and 305hp. We confirm your car's exact specification before supplying a replacement engine.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XK AJ8FT engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include timing chain tensioner wear, water pump and coolant pipe leaks, coil failures and oil leaks. Symptoms overlap, so diagnosis should always come before any repair decision.

faqs.q: Can you deliver an AJ8FT to my local garage?
faqs.a: Yes. Supply-only engines are delivered by pallet across the UK to homes or independent garages. We confirm compatibility before dispatch and explain warranty conditions for outside fitting.

faqs.q: What does your XK supply and fit service include?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed engine, fit the replacement, refill fluids, complete any setup and road test your XK. Timescales are confirmed when we quote.

workshopIntro.title: Deciding the Best Path for Your AJ8FT V8
workshopIntro.description: Start with a thorough diagnosis. Coolant pipe leaks, coil failures and timing solenoid faults can often be put right without removing the engine. If overheating or chain failure has caused internal damage, compare the repair estimate with your XK's condition and value.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XK AJ8FT engine replacement cost depends on the engine type, its history and whether we carry out the fitting. Labour on a V8 grand tourer is substantial, so complete supply and fit quotes give the clearest comparison between suppliers.

When reviewing AJ8FT 4.2 V8 petrol engine UK listings, ask whether the engine came from an XK or a saloon, and whether it is supercharged. Confirm recorded mileage and any pre-sale checks before buying anything.

Warranty cover is worth confirming too. A Jaguar XK AJ8FT engine with warranty protects you if a mechanical fault develops after fitting. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain the terms before you order.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XK AJ8FT Engine Problems Explained
engineProblems.description: These symptoms may point to a fault; diagnosis is needed to confirm.

cards.title: Rattle at Start-Up
cards.description: A brief rattle from the front of the engine on cold starts may suggest worn timing chain tensioners or guides.
cards.action: Book a timing chain inspection promptly.

cards.title: Coolant Leaks at Front
cards.description: Coolant traces near the front or a falling level could indicate a leaking water pump or perished hose.
cards.action: Have the cooling system checked soon.

cards.title: Overheating in Traffic
cards.description: Temperature climbing in slow traffic might relate to a cracked plastic coolant pipe, thermostat housing or cooling fan fault.
cards.action: Stop and arrange a pressure test.

cards.title: Misfire or Rough Idle
cards.description: Shaking at idle, hesitation or a flashing warning light could come from failing ignition coils or worn spark plugs.

cards.title: Oil Around Cam Covers
cards.description: Oil on the cam covers or a burning smell after driving may indicate ageing gaskets or seals letting go.
cards.action: Have the leak traced and assessed.

cards.title: Timing-Related Fault Codes
cards.description: An engine light with camshaft or variable valve timing codes could suggest chain wear or a timing solenoid fault.

engineOverview.title: Inside the 4.2 V8 of the First X150 XK
paragraphs: The AJ8FT is a 4,196cc naturally aspirated V8 from Jaguar's AJ-V8 family, listed in parts catalogues for the XK from 2006. It powered the aluminium-bodied X150 coupé and convertible before the 5.0 arrived, driving the rear wheels through a six-speed automatic gearbox with chain-driven camshafts.

Catalogues quote its output between 298hp and 305hp, depending on the source. A 300PS figure converts to about 296hp, which is why owners search for a Jaguar XK 4.2 V8 petrol engine 296hp. We confirm your exact specification from the VIN.

A Jaguar XK AJ8FT engine 2006 is a genuine match, as the X150 launched that year with this 4.2 V8. The supercharged XKR used a different 4.2 unit, and from 2009 both were replaced by 5.0-litre engines, so we check carefully.
